target.statement: Average ROC AUC of DAO_MLE on synthetic datasets with cluster c2 intrinsic dimension 8 (i.e., both clusters have ID 8), compared to LOF, SLOF, and kNN.
target.dataset: Synthetic two-cluster datasets (30 realizations of the template with c2 ID=8)

compute.basis: The synthetic data generator and all four outlier detection algorithms (DAO, LOF, SLOF, kNN) are provided in the repository; each dataset has 1600 points in 32 dimensions, and the paper reports runtimes of ~0.1s per method per dataset, so 30 datasets with hyperparameter search over k=5..100 should finish in minutes on a CPU.

title: Dimensionality-Aware Outlier Detection: Theoretical and Experimental Analysis
